_purpose: Frozen experimental contract (execution plan Phase 0). Written and committed BEFORE any final-protocol measurement. The analysis code reads these values; none may be changed after data collection starts.

hardware_software.gpu: NVIDIA H200 (sm_90, 132 SMs), single GPU, shared host (other tenants present)

numerical_semantics.operation: C = A*B (alpha=1, beta=0), row-major A[MxK], B[KxN], C[MxN]
numerical_semantics.custom_kernel_math: CUDA-core FFMA only, no Tensor Cores
numerical_semantics.cublas_call: cublasSgemm computing C^T = B^T A^T in column-major (equivalent to row-major C = A B), leading dimensions N, K, N
numerical_semantics.tf32: disallowed: NVIDIA_TF32_OVERRIDE=0 exported for every process; neither math mode enables TF32
numerical_semantics.inputs: uniform[-1,1) from a splitmix64 hash of (seed, index), generated on device; seed 42 (A), 42 xor 0xABCDEF1234567 (B)

correctness.metric: relative Frobenius error ||C_custom - C_cublas||_F / ||C_cublas||_F computed in float64
correctness.tolerance_rationale: pilot: FP32 rounding error vs a float64 CPU reference is ~6e-7 at 1024^3; a deliberately injected fault (one K-tile dropped) produces >= 0.044 at 4096^3. 1e-5 sits ~10x above rounding error and ~4000x below the smallest fault.
correctness.when: every configuration is verified once per shape on its first evaluation; a configuration exceeding tolerance or producing non-finite output is classified numerically_invalid and excluded from every analysis
correctness.independent_check: default and selected configurations additionally checked against a float64 CPU reference at 512^3 and 1024^3

feasibility.constraints: python/design_space.py::is_valid, mirrored 1:1 by static_asserts in cuda/gemm_kernel.cuh; agreement proven over all 2304 candidates (results/feasibility_audit.csv)

timing.boundary: CUDA event pair around each individual kernel launch on the default stream; excludes allocation, initialisation, transfers, verification, compilation
timing.summary_statistic: median of the per-launch latencies within one measurement block; IQR reported; all raw per-launch latencies retained
timing.clock_policy: SM clock lock requested at 1980 MHz and memory at 3201 MHz via nvidia-smi -lgc/-lmc for the entire run; the clock actually achieved under load is recorded per measurement
timing.contention_policy: other tenants share this GPU. For every measurement, NVML per-process SM utilisation samples covering the measurement window are read; if any process other than the benchmark shows smUtil > 0 the measurement is classified contended and repeated (max 6 attempts). The last attempt is kept and flagged if all are contended. Contention counts are reported.
timing.stability_gate: before the experiments, one fixed configuration is measured in 10 separated blocks; proceed only if the coefficient of variation of block medians is <= 1.0%

randomisation.scheme: each experiment is run as R replicate blocks; within a block every design point appears once, in an independently shuffled order. Replicates of the same point therefore never run back to back.

evaluation_definition: one evaluation = one unique feasible configuration on one shape (compile or reuse, verify once, measure with the timing protocol). Replicate blocks and individual launches are NOT separate evaluations.

screening.design: 2^(6-1) fractional factorial, generator F = ABCDE, defining relation I = ABCDEF, resolution VI (main effects aliased only with 5-factor interactions, 2-factor interactions only with 4-factor interactions)
screening.center_points: none: the midpoint of each power-of-two pair is not a legal configuration; pure error comes from 3 replicate blocks
screening.model: TFLOPS ~ block + all main effects + all 2-factor interactions, coded +-1, OLS, Type II ANOVA
screening.retention_rule: at the primary shape, a factor is retained for the response-surface study if its main effect OR any 2-factor interaction containing it is significant at alpha = 0.05. Non-retained factors are fixed at the level with the higher marginal mean TFLOPS.

response_surface.design: central composite design in log2-coded units on the retained factors; factorial core = the screening design restricted to retained factors (2^(6-1) core if 6 retained, full 2^k if k <= 5); 2k axial points at rotatable alpha = (core size)^(1/4); 4 center points
response_surface.coding: x = (log2(level) - c) / h with c, h taken from the screening low/high levels
response_surface.lattice_mapping: each coded point is mapped to the nearest legal power-of-two level per factor (ties resolved to the lower level). The model is fit on the REALISED coded values, not the nominal ones.
response_surface.model: full second-order polynomial (hierarchical) + block term, OLS
diagnostics: lack-of-fit F test vs pure error
residuals vs run order + Durbin-Watson on run order
response_surface.adequacy_gate: optimise only if lack-of-fit p >= 0.01 OR LOF mean square < 5% of model mean square (practically negligible); otherwise report the failure and the remedy tried

optimisation.permitted_region: the factorial box [-1, 1] on every retained coded factor (all joint combinations tested by the factorial core), intersected with the feasible set
methods: SQP (scipy SLSQP, 30 random starts) on the continuous relaxation with the shared-memory and thread-count constraints, then projection to the lattice and its feasible +-1-level neighbourhood
exhaustive evaluation of the fitted model over every feasible lattice configuration inside the permitted region
optimisation.validation: the union of the top-5 model-ranked configurations and the SQP neighbourhood (capped at 12) is benchmarked in 5 randomised replicate blocks; the selected configuration is the one with the best measured median TFLOPS
optimisation.extrapolation_check: the model optimum over the whole feasible set (outside the permitted region) is reported together with its measured value from the exhaustive sweep, to quantify extrapolation error

baselines.exhaustive: all 1396 feasible configurations at 4096^3, randomised order, 1 block, every one verified; the top 20 then re-measured in 3 further randomised blocks to fix t_min robustly
baselines.random_search: equal budget B = number of unique evaluations consumed by DOE-RSM (screening + CCD + validation, primary shape). 10000 random-search trials, each sampling B configurations without replacement from the feasible set, scored with the exhaustive-sweep measurements
baselines.optimality_gap: G = (t(x_hat) - t_min) / t_min * 100%, latencies from the exhaustive sweep (plus top-20 recheck where available)
baselines.cublas: interleaved in-process comparison: 3 randomised process-level blocks per cuBLAS math mode; each process runs 10 internal blocks of 30 custom + 30 cuBLAS launches with the order alternating per block. Configurations: untuned default (64,64,8,4,4,1), DOE-RSM selected configuration, exhaustive best

claims.primary: Classical DOE and RSM can identify a high-performing configuration of this parameterised CUDA SGEMM using fewer empirical evaluations than uninformed search.
claims.secondary: On this H200 / CUDA 13.0 / FP32 / 4096^3 setup the selected kernel attained p% of matched cuBLAS throughput.
claims.never: never claim the statistical optimiser is faster than cuBLAS; never generalise beyond the tested GPU and shapes
